name: com.noskang.skillgraphkit
description: Module-composed skills with an Excel value source and a node graph editor. Skills are built from event + module nodes in three inherited layers; numbers live in spreadsheets; a Python backend expands, validates and round-trips the workbooks.

samples.description: Made-up skills, module dictionary, workbooks, animation clips and settings (skillgraph.json) used by the demo project.
